command: set -u; SERIAL='RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='io.blueeye'; XML='/tmp/tracker-nav-trace.xml'; dump(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-nav-trace.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out cat /sdcard/tracker-nav-trace.xml > "$XML"; }; show(){ echo ---$1---; dump; sed 's/></>\n</g' "$XML" | grep -oE 'text="[^"]+"|content-desc="[^"]+"' | head -n 50; }; coords(){ python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null; sleep 3; show START; dump; c=$(coords content-desc Menu || true); echo menu_coords="$c"; test -n "$c" || exit 21; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 1; show AFTER_MENU; dump; c=$(coords text Settings || true); echo settings_coords="$c"; test -n "$c" || exit 22; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 1; show AFTER_SETTINGS; dump; c=$(coords text 'Alerts & Collection' || true); echo alerts_coords="$c"; test -n "$c" || exit 23; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 1; show ALERTS; dump; c=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable 2>/dev/null || true); echo master_coords="$c"; test -n "$c" || exit 24; echo PHASE3_ALERT_NAVIGATION_TRACE_PASS
